cells.gaps: ONIP said in March 2024 it would manage the data centre and population file, with its trainers trained by the partner (COD-003), but the May 2024 report has the IDEMIA/Afritech consortium managing the file under its 20-year contract (COD-001), and Trident operates RDC-PASS under a 20-year partnership (COD-002). No transfer is shown under way since.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-08: ONIP's March 2024 plan to run the population file is older than the May 2024 account of the consortium managing it, which stands, and Trident runs RDC-PASS. A foreign supplier runs the system, so stage 1.
